create_moonshine_streaming_encoder_confi: create a MoonshineStreamingEncoderConfig instance with custom hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and sliding_windows parameters
create_moonshine_streaming_config: create a MoonshineStreamingConfig instance with custom vocab_size, hidden_size, and encoder_config for the streaming model
initialize_encoder_from_config: initialize a MoonshineStreamingEncoder model from a MoonshineStreamingEncoderConfig configuration object
initialize_model_from_config: initialize a MoonshineStreamingModel from a MoonshineStreamingConfig configuration object
configure_rope_parameters: configure rope_parameters with rope_type, rope_theta, and partial_rotary_factor on MoonshineStreamingConfig
